name: Image Maker
official_name_basis: ChatGPTプラグイン詳細画面の表示名
original_description:
Image Maker designs graphics from your words right in your ChatGPT conversation, in the right size for each platform, and edits pictures you attach.

What it can make:
• Social media posts for Instagram, Facebook, X, LinkedIn and Pinterest, including stories and portrait posts.
• Quote cards, announcements, sale and event posters, invitations and simple flyers.
• Banners and headers for websites, blogs, emails and YouTube channels, and YouTube thumbnails.
• Your own photo as the background, darkened so the text stays readable.

Choose from 12 color themes or your own colors and gradients, five layouts and five font styles. Text works in Latin, Cyrillic, Greek, Hebrew and Arabic letters.

It also edits images: add captions, memes and watermarks, place a logo, make plain backgrounds transparent, put pictures in a collage, make favicons, and resize, crop, convert (including iPhone HEIC photos) or compress any picture. Steps can be chained in one conversation without uploading again, and your original file is never changed.

Privacy: images are processed on the AI Sciences Lab server only to do what you ask. Reading an image keeps nothing. New images are kept behind a private download link for 60 minutes and then deleted automatically. Converting and resizing remove camera and location data. Image contents and file names are not logged.

Limits: files up to 25 MB. Text on images supports Latin, Cyrillic, Greek, Hebrew and Arabic letters; emoji are left out. Transparent backgrounds work for plain backgrounds such as white, not busy photos. For new pictures of scenes, people or objects, use ChatGPT's own image generation, then edit the result here.
